30/* @brief What a controller's float input holds (see ControllerBase::GetInputKind). */
31enum class ControllerInputKind : uint8_t {
32 None, /* Not driven by floats */
33 JointPositions, /* One position per controlled DOF, ascending [rad or m] */
34 Pose, /* Tool frame (EE link * EELinkFromEE) in the root frame: x y z [m], qx qy qz qw */
35 Custom, /* The controller's own layout; only callers that know its type drive it */
36 Count
37};

39/* @brief Base class for all controllers.
40 * Inherits common lifecycle from ComponentBase. Controllers are identified
41 * by string names via RoboticsContext registration, not enums. */
42// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
43class MOCHI_API ControllerBase : public ComponentBase {
44 public:
45 /* @brief Reset internal controller state (e.g., between episodes). */
46 void Reset() override = 0;
47
48 /* @brief The robot-model description this controller was constructed with, or nullptr if none.
49 * Borrowed (not owned); the caller guarantees it outlives the controller. Optional — controllers
50 * that need no model data ignore it. */
51 [[nodiscard]] BotPrefab const* GetBotPrefab() const {
52 return _prefab;
53 }
54
55 /* @brief Configure this controller from serialized parameter and initialization arguments.
56 * @p paramArgs is either a params file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults. @p initArgs is a
57 * controller-specific file path or inline JSON, for example carrying baseLinkName/eeLinkName for
58 * link-resolved controllers. Implementations typically deserialize it into a small reflected
59 * init-args struct and ignore unrecognized framework keys.
60 *
61 * Pure virtual: every controller must implement this uniform configuration entry point. A
62 * controller that cannot support serialized configuration should set @p error with a clear
63 * message rather than silently succeeding.
64 * @param paramArgs Params file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults.
65 * @param initArgs Controller-specific init-argument file path or inline JSON.
66 * @param error Error status. */
67 virtual void ConfigureFromSceneEntry(
68 std::string_view paramArgs,
69 std::string_view initArgs,
70 superdex::Error& error) = 0;
71
72 /* @brief Write constant fields supported by this controller. */
73 virtual void ConfigureRecording(ControllerRecordingSink& sink, superdex::Error& error) const;
74
75 /* @brief Write the most recently computed target and output, if available. */
76 virtual void Record(ControllerRecordingSink& sink, superdex::Error& error) const;
77
78 /* @brief How many floats ComputeOutputFromInput takes; 0 when floats cannot drive it. */
79 [[nodiscard]] virtual int GetInputSize() const;
80
81 /* @brief What those floats are. */
82 [[nodiscard]] virtual ControllerInputKind GetInputKind() const;
83
84 /* @brief The actor DOFs it drives, ascending. A JointPositions input lists them, and
85 * ComputeOutputFromInput writes their efforts. Empty when unknown. */
86 [[nodiscard]] virtual Span<int const> GetControlledDofs() const;
87
88 /* @brief Writes the input that holds the robot where it is now. @p input must be GetInputSize()
89 * wide. */
90 virtual void GetCurrentInput(Span<real> input, superdex::Error& error);
91
92 /* @brief Reads the live actor and writes into @p efforts (one per actor DOF, zero on DOFs it
93 * does not control) what the typed ComputeOutput gives for @p input over @p dt [s]. @p input must
94 * be GetInputSize() wide. */
95 virtual void ComputeOutputFromInput(
96 Span<real const> input,
97 real dt,
98 Span<real> efforts,
99 superdex::Error& error);
100
101 protected:
102 /* @brief Common controller constructor archetype: stores the (optionally null) @p actor via
103 * ComponentBase together with the optional borrowed @p prefab (see GetBotPrefab). A null Actor is
104 * permitted so controllers can be constructed without a live Mochi scene (e.g. on a real robot);
105 * controllers that require an Actor enforce that themselves. A non-null Actor must be an
106 * articulated body. Every controller delegates to this, then bails on error before performing its
107 * own initialization. */
108 ControllerBase(BotPrefab const* prefab, Actor* actor, superdex::Error& error)
109 : ComponentBase(actor), _prefab(prefab) {
110 if (actor != nullptr) {
111 MOCHI_ERROR_IF(
112 actor->GetType() != ActorType::Articulated, error, "Actor is not an articulated body");
113 }
114 }
115
116 /* @brief Build an actor-scoped link name ("<botActorName>/<linkName>") for link resolution during
117 * ConfigureFromSceneEntry. Requires a non-null Actor (link-resolved controllers need one). */
118 [[nodiscard]] std::string QualifiedLinkName(std::string_view linkName) const {
119 Actor* const actor = GetActor();
120 char const* actorName = actor != nullptr ? actor->GetName() : nullptr;
121 return std::string(actorName != nullptr ? actorName : "") + "/" + std::string(linkName);
122 }
123
124 /* Borrowed robot-model description (see GetBotPrefab); nullptr when constructed without a model.
125 */
126 BotPrefab const* _prefab = nullptr;
127};
